verdicts.reason: A is a clean top-to-bottom story: headline, product centred on its purple circle (kept as a deliberate backdrop), CTA, then fine print, all sharing one left edge. Its flaws are minor: the CTA sits a long way below the copy, and there is a large dead gap above the bottom legal line. B has collided the purple circle with the headline, so 'WEEKEND ONLY' and '20% off' sit half on and half off the blob. The text is blown up so large that '20% off' and the CTA crowd the right edge. The product floats with no circle behind it, and the legal line is oversized, almost competing with the message.
